import sys
from datetime import date

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import daily
import weekly

events = [
    {"user": "ada", "day": date(2026, 11, 14)},
    {"user": "ada", "day": date(2026, 11, 14)},
    {"user": "bob", "day": date(2026, 11, 13)},
    {"user": "cy", "day": date(2026, 11, 10)},
    {"user": "cy", "day": date(2026, 11, 9)},
    {"user": "cy", "day": date(2026, 11, 8)},
    {"user": "dee", "day": date(2026, 11, 7)},
    {"user": "eve", "day": date(2026, 11, 12)},
    {"user": "fay", "day": date(2026, 11, 15)},
]
daily.main(events)
weekly.main(events)
print(daily.build_report([], date(2026, 1, 1)))
print(weekly.build_report([], date(2026, 1, 1)))
print("ok")
